fields.label: Route Name
fields.description: The slug used in the routes /synapse/d/<name> and /app/synapse-view/<name>. Lowercase, no spaces.

fields.label: Data Source
fields.description: Query: each widget names its data (DocType, totals, grouping) and Synapse runs it live. No code. Script: one Synapse Script returns all widget data, for logic a query cannot express. Assistant: a connected LLM stores the data with publish_dashboard_snapshot. Assistant pages have no filters.

fields.label: View
fields.description: Dashboard: sections of widgets. Report: filters and one full width table.

fields.label: Group
fields.description: Sidebar group in the Synapse app, for example Sales or Finance.

fields.label: Description
fields.description: Shown on the dashboard card in the Synapse app.

fields.options: Layout is the Synapse UI config as JSON: filters, sections and widgets (dashboard), or filters and table options (report). Each widget key matches a key in the data. On Query dashboards each widget has a query, for example {"doctype": "Sales Invoice", "metrics": ["sum:base_grand_total"], "group_by": ["customer"]}, and bind maps page filters to its fields. Ask your MCP assistant for get_dashboard_guide for the full format.

fields.label: Brief for the Assistant
fields.description: What this dashboard should track. The assistant reads this when it refreshes the page.

fields.label: Assistant Notes
fields.description: The assistant's summary and reasoning, shown on the dashboard.

fields.label: Legacy Blocks
fields.description: Blocks for the older desk viewer at /app/synapse-view. The Synapse app uses Layout instead.
